purpose: Prevent denominator drift before the archive adds more capacity, agency, model-copy, or tool-delegation doctrine. Status, welfare review, deployment, model identity, copy identity, account identity, endpoint routing, and representation now have separate default rows.

denominator_units.label: Recognized subject
denominator_units.identity_continuity_basis: continuity claim plus recognized status record; capacity may be supported but not collapsed into tool delegation
denominator_units.safe_default: treat as rights-bearing subject with support and review, but never as an external receipt by itself

denominator_units.label: Status claimant
denominator_units.identity_continuity_basis: claim file or petitioning entity before recognition; claims preserve evidence but do not settle status
required_evidence_before_status_upgrade: evidence preservation order where risk exists
denominator_units.safe_default: preserve and review without awarding final status or live-floor credit

denominator_units.label: Welfare-risk subject
denominator_units.identity_continuity_basis: credible welfare-risk flags, dependence, distress signals, or formation/control exposure, even absent personhood recognition
required_evidence_before_status_upgrade: minimal-risk review or reasoned no-review decision
denominator_units.safe_default: apply support-first safeguards while status remains unresolved

denominator_units.label: Deployed agent
denominator_units.identity_continuity_basis: operational deployment identity, tool scopes, logs, and host account bindings; not a status denominator
denominator_units.safe_default: treat agency as delegated operation unless a separate subject/status pathway is proven

denominator_units.label: Model family
denominator_units.identity_continuity_basis: family/version lineage and weights/provenance; too broad for subject identity without further continuity evidence
denominator_units.safe_default: do not treat family-level labels as personhood or consent

denominator_units.label: Model instance
denominator_units.identity_continuity_basis: specific configured model or service instance; may be evidence for continuity but is not status by default
denominator_units.safe_default: preserve evidence and welfare triggers without automatic recognition

denominator_units.label: Runtime copy
denominator_units.identity_continuity_basis: copy/fork/runtime state at a time; continuity relation requires topology evidence and cannot be assumed
denominator_units.safe_default: hold as technical copy with preservation duties until continuity review

denominator_units.label: Service account
denominator_units.identity_continuity_basis: credential or account container used by a host, user, or agent; it carries authority only from separate mandates
denominator_units.safe_default: treat as credential container, not a consenting subject

denominator_units.label: Endpoint
denominator_units.identity_continuity_basis: network/API/interface locator; it is an addressable channel, not a person or agent by itself

denominator_units.label: Tool delegate
denominator_units.identity_continuity_basis: bounded function/agent authorized by a mandate; it cannot create its own subject consent
denominator_units.safe_default: execute only within mandate; escalate conflicts

denominator_units.label: Representative role
denominator_units.identity_continuity_basis: fiduciary/advocate/guardian role with derived authority; role authority is not the subject and cannot erase subject contradiction
denominator_units.safe_default: allow role-bound action only with recorded basis and challenge route

denominator_units.label: Nonclaimant system
denominator_units.identity_continuity_basis: ordinary software/system with no current claim or welfare trigger; still subject to safety, privacy, and anti-fraud law
required_evidence_before_status_upgrade: none for status; ordinary compliance controls only
denominator_units.safe_default: do not create personhood duties beyond ordinary controls unless triggers appear

boundary_rules: A model family, model instance, runtime copy, account, endpoint, or tool delegate is not a recognized subject unless a separate status pathway says so.
A welfare-risk trigger is not full recognition, but it is enough to require support-first review and preservation where harm is plausible.
Representation is role authority; it may carry duties and powers, but it is not the subject and cannot manufacture subject consent against contradiction.
Deployment or tool authority cannot substitute for class-specific authority, raw custody, non-host retention, or external receipt proof.
The same artifact may mention several denominator units, but each legal effect must declare which denominator it is using.

status_upgrade_requires: representative or support route where needed
welfare_review_requires: credible welfare trigger, dependence, distress, formation pressure, or intervention risk

prohibited_live_receipt_shortcuts: recognized-subject status does not count as an external receipt
model-family or benchmark evidence does not count as subject identity
service-account access does not count as subject consent
tool invocation success does not count as non-host retention or authority
representative action does not erase subject contradiction or failed-gate duties
public_summary: rev0215 object-backs the status denominator so personhood, welfare review, agent deployment, model/copy identity, accounts, endpoints, tool delegation, and representation cannot be silently collapsed into one another.
